items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: we organized a band there called the Alexander's Ragtime Jazz Band. Old Dave Alexander, we named it after him. He was well known.

ctx.x: Want to go there? One time? Yeah.

I want to hear that myself. Well now let's see, I was telling you about going down to Houston there. And I learned to lead a bunch of fellas, what the responsibilities was, and did pretty good after that. I started. And I went off with a left here and left Sid Iles, and went off with a carnival, carnival show. The boys said they were going down to Mexico and I'd never been to Mexico and I wanted to get away and go down to Mexico. So I just forgot about school and went on down there. The old man Sid Iles, he had…
About what year was that? That was long about 1921.
